name: Viva Goods Company Limited
summary: Viva Goods Company Limited engages in the design, development, branding, and sale of sports and lifestyle apparel and footwear in the United Kingdom, the Republic of Ireland, the United States, the People's Republic of China, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It operates in two segments, Multi-Brand Apparel and Footwear, and Sports Experience. The company offers apparel and footwear, as well as lifestyle products under the Clarks, Bossini/bossini.X, LNG, and TESTONI.
